The file even contains a dead duplicate buildSlots() (208-216) with a comment 'fix accidental syntax' (217) followed by buildSlots2() (218-226) that repeats the same error. Capped at 1.

bugs.text: Extra ')' at the end of the zako slot loop in both buildSlots and buildSlots2 is a SyntaxError; the whole script fails to parse, the page stays black and nothing runs (result.json pageerror 'Unexpected token )', all screenshots blank). The author noticed ('fix accidental syntax', 217) and duplicated the function with the same error.

Challenging stage never ends on its own: fly-through enemies get a dummy slot at (112,120), switch to 'slot' when their path ends, pile up at that point as formation enemies, can dive and fire, and the stage only finishes when the player has shot all of them.

text(s,x,y,size,color,align) is called without the size argument everywhere but two places: the colour lands in size (invalid font string, previous font kept), 'center' lands in color (invalid, previous fillStyle kept), alignment is never applied. Title lines are all 30px, left-aligned and run off the canvas; HUD 1UP/score overlap; stage-badge digits are painted in the badge colour and invisible.
Stage-clear, challenge-results, game-over and results timers tick in render() per rAF, so their lengths depend on refresh rate and keep running while paused.
Dual fighter: any hit destroys the whole dual ship and costs a life instead of removing one half.

Captive freed as a hostile when its Boss is shot in formation dives once, then returns to the Boss's slot and sits in formation (can dive again, scores 100); if the Boss is in 'slot' state the captive silently disappears.
Challenge-stage hits score 100/160/400 by type instead of 100 each, and challenge Bosses need two hits.
Space fires only on frames where frame%7===0; a short tap often does nothing, holding Space auto-fires. fireLatch is never used.
Player body hitbox for ramming is 24x24 per ship, larger than the 16x16 sprite.
A diving enemy can ram the player while it is being pulled up by the beam (captureAnim not checked at 556); killPlayer and then finishCapture both take a life.
escortOf is never cleared, so Goei that escorted once are never picked again and a stale escort still diving later inflates a Boss kill to 800/1600.
Boss Galaga sprite is the Goei shape recoloured green; the score table lists two 150-point 'GALAGA'/'BOSS GALAGA' rows and no diving values.
readyTimer=60 at stage start expires during the 90-frame STAGE N intro, so there is no READY at the start of a stage and the dive lock-out ends before play begins.
SFX.enemyHit is never called; a Boss kill plays the Boss-hit sound instead of the destroyed sound.

summary: Taken as a design, this is a compact and fairly complete Galaga: a 60 Hz accumulator loop, pixel sprites with wing frames, Bezier group entries into a 4/16/20 formation that sways then breathes, stage-scaled dives with aimed fire and top re-entry, Boss escorts with the 400/800/1600 rule, a widening tractor beam with capture, rescue, docking and a firing captive, challenge waves, localStorage high score and a synthesized sound set. As delivered it does not run at all: a stray ')' on line 215 (and again on 225, in a function the author added to 'fix accidental syntax') is a parse error, so the harness sees only a black page from load to end and every check but the canvas and survive-without-crash fails. Even with that one character removed the game would be noticeably rough: every HUD and title string is drawn through a text() helper with its arguments shifted, so the title is a 30px left-aligned jumble running off the canvas and badge digits are invisible; the challenging stage strands its enemies in a pile that must be shot down; the dual fighter dies whole; state timers run inside render. Code quality is readable and sectioned, but the leftover duplicate function, unused helpers and the unchecked helper signature show it was never run once.
